item.title: AIM movers: Wellnex Life sells Pain Away brand and ex-dividends
item.summary: Wellnex Life Ltd (LON:WNX) is selling its main brand Pain Away to Japan-based Rohto Pharmaceutical for up to A$21.3m. The initial cash payment of A$19.8m is payable on completion and will be used to repay debt and invest in the remaining healthcare and contract manufacturing activities.
